[[Spafrod Iceblood]] is a [[Charr]] [[boss]] who spawns in the Charr stronghold in northwestern [[Sacnoth Valley]], only after [[Assault on the Stronghold]].

==Locations==
*[[Charr Homelands]]
**{{NPC location|Sacnoth Valley}} (except during [[Forbidden Fruit]])

==Skills==
* {{Skill icon|Aura of Restoration}}
* {{Skill icon|Blurred Vision}}
* {{Skill icon|Deep Freeze}}
* {{Skill icon|Ward Against Elements}}
* {{Skill icon|Ward Against Harm}} ([[elite]])
* {{Skill icon|Ward Against Melee}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Charr Armor]]
*[[Iceblood's Warstaff]] ([[unique]])
*[[Superb Charr Carving]]

{{anomaly|Despite wielding a staff with the usual range and attack speed, the projectiles fired appear as spears.}}

==Trivia==
*Named after [[Austin Spafford]] ([http://wiki.guildwars.com/index.php?title=User_talk:Emily_Diehl/Trivia_archive_2&oldid=447273#Edielh_Shockhunter source]).
*Before the [[Game updates/20080529|May 29, 2008]] update, Spafrod Iceblood would incorrectly [[drop]] [[Lord Glacius' Staff]].
